indicators.name: 收入
indicators.definition: 已完成销售订单的不含税收入，按订单日汇率折算为人民币
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency

indicators.name: 销售成本
indicators.definition: 已完成订单中，材料成本与人工成本之和乘以销售数量
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id

indicators.name: 毛利
indicators.definition: 人民币销售收入减去销售成本
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency

indicators.name: 毛利率
indicators.definition: 毛利占人民币销售收入的比例
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency

indicators.name: 期间费用
indicators.definition: 研发、销售、管理和财务四类总项费用之和，不重复加入销售费用子项
indicators.data_source: finance_expenses f

indicators.name: 利润
indicators.definition: 毛利减去期间费用，销售与费用必须使用一致的时间粒度
indicators.data_source: sales_orders、dim_products、exchange_rates 与 finance_expenses 分别按同一时间粒度聚合后关联

indicators.name: 利润率
indicators.definition: 利润占人民币销售收入的比例
indicators.data_source: sales_orders、dim_products、exchange_rates 与 finance_expenses 分别按同一时间粒度聚合后关联

indicators.name: 完成订单数
indicators.definition: 状态为 completed 的销售订单数量
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o

indicators.name: 销售数量
indicators.definition: 已完成销售订单的商品数量之和
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o

indicators.name: 平均订单金额
indicators.definition: 已完成订单的人民币收入除以完成订单数
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency

indicators.name: 平均销售单价
indicators.definition: 已完成订单的人民币收入除以销售数量
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency

indicators.name: 销售折扣金额
indicators.definition: 已完成销售订单的折扣金额之和，原币口径必须按币种分组
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 o.currency 分组

indicators.name: 成交客户数
indicators.definition: 已完成订单中的去重客户数量
indicators.data_source: sales_orders o

indicators.name: 采购金额
indicators.definition: 采购订单总金额，原币口径；跨币种分析必须按 currency 分组，禁止直接相加
indicators.data_source: purchase_orders po
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 po.currency 分组

indicators.name: 采购订单数
indicators.definition: 采购订单去重数量
indicators.data_source: purchase_orders po

indicators.name: 采购数量
indicators.definition: 采购订单明细的订购数量之和
indicators.data_source: purchase_order_items poi JOIN purchase_orders po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id

indicators.name: 已收货数量
indicators.definition: 采购订单明细中已经收货的数量之和
indicators.data_source: purchase_order_items poi JOIN purchase_orders po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id

indicators.name: 采购收货率
indicators.definition: 已收货数量占采购数量的比例
indicators.data_source: purchase_order_items poi JOIN purchase_orders po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id

indicators.name: 平均采购单价
indicators.definition: 采购明细金额除以采购数量，跨币种分析必须按采购订单币种分组
indicators.data_source: purchase_order_items poi JOIN purchase_orders po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 po.currency 分组

indicators.name: 活跃供应商数
indicators.definition: 状态为 active 的供应商数量
indicators.data_source: dim_suppliers s
indicators.time_field: 无固定时间字段（当前快照）

indicators.name: 供应商平均评分
indicators.definition: 供应商 rating 字段的平均值
indicators.data_source: dim_suppliers s
indicators.time_field: 无固定时间字段（当前快照）

indicators.name: 库存数量
indicators.definition: 指定库存快照日的账面现存数量之和
indicators.data_source: inventory_balances ib
filters: 未指定日期时使用 MAX(snapshot_date) 的最新快照

indicators.name: 预留库存数量
indicators.definition: 指定库存快照日已被业务预留的库存数量
indicators.data_source: inventory_balances ib
filters: 未指定日期时使用 MAX(snapshot_date) 的最新快照

indicators.name: 可用库存
indicators.definition: 账面现存数量减去预留库存数量
indicators.data_source: inventory_balances ib
filters: 未指定日期时使用 MAX(snapshot_date) 的最新快照

indicators.name: 库存金额
indicators.definition: 指定库存快照日的库存价值之和
indicators.data_source: inventory_balances ib
filters: 未指定日期时使用 MAX(snapshot_date) 的最新快照

indicators.name: 库存预留率
indicators.definition: 预留库存数量占库存数量的比例
indicators.data_source: inventory_balances ib
filters: 未指定日期时使用 MAX(snapshot_date) 的最新快照

indicators.name: 入库数量
indicators.definition: 库存流水中 transaction_type 为 inbound 的正向数量之和
indicators.data_source: inventory_transactions it

indicators.name: 出库数量
indicators.definition: 库存流水中 transaction_type 为 outbound 的绝对数量之和
indicators.data_source: inventory_transactions it

indicators.name: 计划生产数量
indicators.definition: 生产工单计划数量之和
indicators.data_source: production_orders mo

indicators.name: 实际产出数量
indicators.definition: 生产产出中良品数量与不良品数量之和
indicators.data_source: production_outputs prod_out JOIN production_orders mo ON prod_out.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 良品数量
indicators.definition: 生产产出中的良品数量之和
indicators.data_source: production_outputs prod_out JOIN production_orders mo ON prod_out.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 不良品数量
indicators.definition: 生产产出中的不良品数量之和
indicators.data_source: production_outputs prod_out JOIN production_orders mo ON prod_out.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 生产完成率
indicators.definition: 实际产出数量占计划生产数量的比例
indicators.data_source: production_orders mo LEFT JOIN production_outputs prod_out ON mo.production_order_id = prod_out.production_order_id

indicators.name: 生产良率
indicators.definition: 良品数量占实际产出数量的比例
indicators.data_source: production_outputs prod_out JOIN production_orders mo ON prod_out.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 检验数量
indicators.definition: 质量检验记录中的检验数量之和
indicators.data_source: quality_inspections qi JOIN production_orders mo ON qi.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 检验合格数量
indicators.definition: 质量检验记录中的合格数量之和
indicators.data_source: quality_inspections qi JOIN production_orders mo ON qi.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 检验合格率
indicators.definition: 检验合格数量占检验数量的比例
indicators.data_source: quality_inspections qi JOIN production_orders mo ON qi.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 检验缺陷率
indicators.definition: 检验数量减合格数量后，占检验数量的比例
indicators.data_source: quality_inspections qi JOIN production_orders mo ON qi.production_order_id = mo.production_order_id

indicators.name: 设备数量
indicators.definition: 设备台账中的设备数量
indicators.data_source: equipment e

indicators.name: 在运设备数量
indicators.definition: 状态为 running 的设备数量
indicators.data_source: equipment e

indicators.name: 设备维护次数
indicators.definition: 设备维护记录数量
indicators.data_source: equipment_maintenance em JOIN equipment e ON em.equipment_id = e.equipment_id

indicators.name: 设备维护成本
indicators.definition: 设备维护记录中的维护成本之和
indicators.data_source: equipment_maintenance em JOIN equipment e ON em.equipment_id = e.equipment_id

indicators.name: 设备停机时长
indicators.definition: 设备维护导致的停机小时数之和
indicators.data_source: equipment_maintenance em JOIN equipment e ON em.equipment_id = e.equipment_id

indicators.name: 发运单数
indicators.definition: 发运单的去重数量
indicators.data_source: shipments sh

indicators.name: 发运数量
indicators.definition: 发运明细中的发货数量之和
indicators.data_source: shipment_items si JOIN shipments sh ON si.shipment_id = sh.shipment_id

indicators.name: 运费
indicators.definition: 发运单中的运费之和
indicators.data_source: shipments sh

indicators.name: 客户回款金额
indicators.definition: 已收到和部分收到的客户付款金额，原币口径；跨币种必须按 currency 分组
indicators.data_source: customer_payments cp JOIN sales_orders o ON cp.order_id = o.order_id
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 cp.currency 分组

indicators.name: 客户回款率
indicators.definition: 客户回款金额占对应销售订单不含税金额的比例，按相同订单和币种计算
indicators.data_source: customer_payments cp JOIN sales_orders o ON cp.order_id = o.order_id
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 cp.currency 分组

indicators.name: 供应商付款金额
indicators.definition: 已支付和部分支付的供应商付款金额，原币口径；跨币种必须按 currency 分组
indicators.data_source: supplier_payments sp JOIN purchase_orders po ON sp.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 sp.currency 分组

indicators.name: 采购付款率
indicators.definition: 供应商付款金额占对应采购订单金额的比例，按相同采购订单和币种计算
indicators.data_source: supplier_payments sp JOIN purchase_orders po ON sp.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id
filters: 跨币种汇总时按 sp.currency 分组

indicators.name: 预算金额
indicators.definition: 预算记录中的预算金额之和
indicators.data_source: budgets b JOIN dim_cost_centers cc ON b.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id

indicators.name: 实际发生金额
indicators.definition: 预算记录中的实际发生金额之和
indicators.data_source: budgets b JOIN dim_cost_centers cc ON b.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id

indicators.name: 预算差异
indicators.definition: 预算金额减去实际发生金额；正数为结余，负数为超支
indicators.data_source: budgets b JOIN dim_cost_centers cc ON b.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id

indicators.name: 预算执行率
indicators.definition: 实际发生金额占预算金额的比例
indicators.data_source: budgets b JOIN dim_cost_centers cc ON b.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id

indicators.name: 员工人数
indicators.definition: 员工维度表中的员工数量
indicators.data_source: dim_employees e JOIN dim_departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id

indicators.name: 在职员工数
indicators.definition: 状态为 active 的员工数量
indicators.data_source: dim_employees e JOIN dim_departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id

indicators.name: 仓库容量
indicators.definition: 仓库维度表中的容量之和，单位 MWh
indicators.data_source: dim_warehouses w
indicators.time_field: 无固定时间字段（当前快照）

indicators.name: 成本中心年度预算
indicators.definition: 成本中心维度中配置的年度预算之和
indicators.data_source: dim_cost_centers cc JOIN dim_departments d ON cc.department_id = d.department_id
indicators.time_field: 无固定时间字段（年度配置快照）

indicators.name: 销售渠道数
indicators.definition: 销售渠道维度表中的渠道数量
indicators.data_source: dim_sales_channels sc
indicators.time_field: 无固定时间字段（当前快照）

indicators.name: 工作日数
indicators.definition: 日历维度中标记为工作日的日期数量
indicators.data_source: dim_calendar c

indicators.name: 客户总数
indicators.definition: 客户维度表中的客户总数量，不要求客户已经成交
indicators.data_source: dim_customers c
indicators.time_field: 无固定时间字段（当前快照）
